codeReview.summary: The rerun adequately fixes the prior scrutiny blockers. Compared with the original `132054d` diff that introduced `TestableInputRecordingHost`/`TestableInputRecordingRuntime`, commit `7f1e44d` moves the observability seam onto the real `WinSwiftUIWindowHost` and drives the real host delegate methods in `WinSwiftUIWindowHostTests`. `Sources/WinSwiftUI/App.swift` now records pointer, wheel, keyboard, and focus-loss events only after delegating to `RetainedViewRuntime`, `Sources/SwiftWindowsPlatform/Win32Host.swift` adds a test-only scale-factor override so conversion still uses the production `window.scaleFactor` seam, and the updated tests assert converted values by calling `host.window(...)` / `host.windowDidLoseKeyboardFocus(...)` directly. That is sufficient validator-visible proof for VAL-CROSS-004, VAL-CROSS-005, and VAL-CROSS-006 through the real host path.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Windows worker startup still depends on invoking `.factory/init.sh` via `bash`, which fails on this Windows-only machine without a WSL distribution; the worker had to fall back to `windows-swift-env.ps1 -CheckOnly` even though the rest of the procedure was followed.
